name: Whispers in the Orchard
author: Fidgetfall
description: An original 10-character demo script written for this server. Unlike the base editions it ships with full ability text, so a game can be run with no extra data files. Balanced for 7-12 players.

name: Orchardist
ability: You start knowing two players, at least one of whom is evil.
firstNightReminder: Point to two players, at least one of whom is evil.

name: Beekeeper
ability: Each night*, you learn how many of your two living neighbours are evil.
otherNightReminder: Show the number of evil living neighbours on your fingers.

name: Cellarman
ability: Each night, choose a player other than yourself: they cannot be killed by the Blight tonight.
firstNightReminder: The Cellarman points to a player. Mark that player Sheltered.
otherNightReminder: The Cellarman points to a player. Mark that player Sheltered.

name: Cooper
ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Blight, they die.

name: Windvane
ability: You start knowing one good character that is not in play.
firstNightReminder: Show one good character token that is not in play.

name: Sleepwalker
ability: You cannot whisper. All of your conversations happen in the town square.

name: Windfall
ability: If you nominate a player, your vote does not count today.

name: Crowherd
ability: Each night, choose a player: the Storyteller may give them false information tomorrow.
firstNightReminder: The Crowherd points to a player. Mark that player Misled.
otherNightReminder: The Crowherd points to a player. Mark that player Misled.

name: Magpie
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: you learn their character.
otherNightReminder: If the Magpie has not used their ability, they may point to a player. Show that player's character token.

name: Blight
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. You also learn one good character that is not in play.
otherNightReminder: The Blight points to a player. That player dies. Then show one good character token that is not in play.
